items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Calvin and I went to school together... I didn't mention him. He was a few years ahead of me... Well, I didn't know you and Calvin went back that far. I knew you were tight friends. Yeah. Well, we were kids together.

ctx.x: Mmm-hmm, and who's married to the great artist Calvin Bailey, who is my... Calvin and I went to school together...
